sentences.l1: The ancient Romans were very clever.

sentences.l2: 他们建造了很长的管道，把水从很远的山上送到城市。
sentences.l1: They built very long pipes to carry water from distant mountains to the cities.

sentences.l2: 输水渠是他们重要的工程技术。
sentences.l1: Aqueducts were their important engineering technology.

sentences.l2: 有了这些输水渠，人们就有干净的水用。
sentences.l1: With these aqueducts, people had clean water to use.

sentences.l2: 古罗马的供水系统非常棒。
sentences.l1: The ancient Roman water supply system was excellent.

sentences.l2: 这是他们建造的重要基础设施，让城市生活变得更好。
sentences.l1: This was important infrastructure that they built, making city life better.
